description: Post-remediation regression run. Same 160 questions as the original blind holdout, executed after 7 code fixes were applied. This result validates correction of known failures but is NOT an independent estimate of generalization.
methodology_note: The initial 160-question execution was the blind holdout evaluation (135/160, 84.4%). After its failures were inspected and the implementation was modified, the same dataset became a remediation and regression suite. The 160/160 result confirms correction of known failures but is not an independent estimate of generalization.
